essence: After worship, one should offer Śiva's remnants.
The prescribed daily worship grants the fruits of enjoyment and liberation.
By worshipping Caṇḍeśa one always obtains another benefit.
The bathing is as before, but Caṇḍeśvara is placed in the middle of the pot.
In the arrangement of eight forms, five stand in the directions beginning with the east.
